objective_summary.value: The investigation used numerical simulation to explore how gravity affects pyrolysis smoke growth. It aimed to quantify differences between microgravity and Earth gravity smoke and identify the fluid dynamic mechanisms involved.
objective_summary.quote: The objective of this investigation was to use numerical simulation to explore the influence of gravity on pyrolysis smoke growth from a fundamental perspective.
